verses.text: Na di beginning of di Good News about Jesus Christ, God Pikin.
Just as e dey write for di prophets, “Look, I dey send my messenger go before you, wey go prepare your way before you.
Na di voice of one person wey dey shout for di wilderness, ‘Make una prepare di way for Lord! Make una straighten im paths!’”
John come baptize for di wilderness, and e preach di baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
All di country of Judea and all di people of Jerusalem go meet am. Im baptize dem for Jordan River as dem dey confess dem sins.
John dey wear cloth wey dem make from camel hair, and leather belt dey tie for im waist. E dey chop locusts and wild honey.
E dey preach, e talk say, “Somebody wey strong pass me dey come after me. I no even worthy to bend down loose di strap of im sandals.
I baptize una with water, but e go baptize una with Holy Spirit.”
For those days, Jesus come from Nazareth for Galilee, and John baptize am for Jordan.
As e just dey come up from di water, e see di heavens open, and di Spirit come down on am like dove.
One voice come from heaven talk say, “You na my beloved Pikin, I dey pleased with you.”
At once di Spirit drive am go di wilderness.
E stay for di wilderness 40 days and Satan dey tempt am. E dey with di wild animals, and di angels dey serve am.
After dem arrest John, Jesus come Galilee, e dey preach di Good News about God Kingdom,
and e dey talk say, “Di time don reach, and God Kingdom don near! Repent, and believe di Good News.”
As e dey waka pass di Sea of Galilee, e see Simon and im brother Andrew as dem dey throw net inside di sea, because dem na fishermen.
Jesus talk to dem say, “Follow me, and I go make una dey fish for people.”
At once dem leave dem nets and follow am.
As e go small further from there, e see James, Zebedee son, and im brother John, as dem dey inside di boat dey mend di nets.
At once e call dem, and dem leave dem papa Zebedee inside di boat with di people wey dem hire, and follow am.
Dem enter Capernaum, and at once for Sabbath day e enter di synagogue and teach.
Im teaching shock dem, because e dey teach dem like person wey get authority, no be like di scribes.
At once one man wey get evil spirit dey for dem synagogue, and e shout,
talk say, “Ha! Wetin we get to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? You don come destroy us? I know who you be: di Holy One of God!”
Jesus rebuke am, talk say, “Keep quiet, and come out of am!”
Di evil spirit shake di man hard and shout with loud voice, den e come out of am.
Dem all shock so tay dem dey ask one another, “Wetin be this? New teaching? Na with authority e dey command even di evil spirits, and dem dey obey am!”
Di news about am spread at once everywhere for all di region of Galilee and di places around.
As soon as dem leave di synagogue, dem go Simon and Andrew house with James and John.
Simon wife mama dey sick for bed with fever, and at once dem tell am about di woman.
E come, hold di woman hand, raise am up. Di fever leave am, and e serve dem.
For evening, after sun don set, dem bring all di sick people and di people wey evil spirits dey control come meet am.
All di town gather for di door.
E heal plenty people wey get different kind of sickness, and drive out plenty evil spirits. E no allow di evil spirits talk, because dem know am.
Early for morning, while e still dey dark, e get up, go out, go one place wey nobody dey, and pray there.
Simon and di people wey dey with am follow am go;
dem find am, and talk to am say, “Everybody dey look for you.”
E talk to dem say, “Make we go another place, to di towns wey near, so that I fit preach there too, because na for this reason I come.”
E go dem synagogues for all Galilee, dey preach and dey drive out evil spirits.
One man wey get leprosy come meet am, dey beg am, kneel down before am and talk say, “If you want, you fit make me clean.”
Compassion move am, e stretch out im hand, touch di man, and talk say, “I want. Be clean.”
As e talk am finish, di leprosy leave di man at once, and e clean.
E warn am strongly, den send am go at once,
talk say, “Make sure say you no tell anybody, but go show yourself to di priest, and offer di things wey Moses command for your cleansing, as testimony to dem.”

But di man go out, begin to talk about am plenty, and spread di matter everywhere, so tay Jesus no fit enter any town openly again, but stay outside for places wey nobody dey. And people dey come to am from everywhere.
After some days, Jesus enter Capernaum again, and dem hear say e dey inside di house.
At once plenty people gather so tay no more space dey, even for di door too. And e dey talk di word to dem.
Four people come, dem carry one paralyzed man come meet am.
Because of di crowd, dem no fit reach am, so dem open di roof for wia e dey. As dem don break am, dem lower di mat wey di paralyzed man dey lie on.
Jesus see dem faith, e talk to di paralyzed man say, “My son, dem don forgive your sins.”
But some of di scribes dey sit there, dey think for dem heart say,
“Why this man dey talk like this? E dey blaspheme! Who fit forgive sins except God alone?”
At once Jesus know for im spirit say na so dem dey reason inside dem, and e talk to dem say, “Why una dey think these things for una heart?
Which one easy pass: to talk to di paralyzed man say, ‘Dem don forgive your sins,’ or to talk say, ‘Get up, carry your mat, and waka’?
But make una know say di Son of Man get authority for earth to forgive sins,” e talk to di paralyzed man,
“I dey tell you, get up, carry your mat, and go your house.”
At once di man get up, carry di mat, and go out before dem all, so tay dem all shock and dem praise God, dey talk say, “We never see anything like this before!”
Jesus go out again to di seaside. All di crowd come to am, and e teach dem.
As e dey pass, e see Levi, Alphaeus son, as e dey sit for di tax office, and e talk to am say, “Follow me.” Levi get up and follow am.
As Jesus dey sit for table for Levi house, plenty tax collectors and sinners sit down with Jesus and im disciples, because dem plenty and dem dey follow am.
When di scribes and di Pharisees see say e dey chop with di sinners and tax collectors, dem talk to im disciples say, “Why e dey chop and drink with tax collectors and sinners?”
When Jesus hear am, e talk to dem say, “Di people wey strong no need doctor, but di sick people need am. I no come to call di righteous, but sinners so that dem repent.”
John disciples and di Pharisees dey fast. Some people come ask am, “Why John disciples and di Pharisees disciples dey fast, but your own disciples no dey fast?”
Jesus talk to dem say, “Di friends of di groom fit fast while di groom dey with dem? As long as dem get di groom with dem, dem no fit fast.
But days go come wey dem go take di groom away from dem, and for that day dem go fast.
Nobody dey sew piece of new cloth wey never shrink put for old cloth, because di new piece go shrink and pull di old cloth, den di hole go worse pass before.
Nobody dey put new wine inside old wineskins, because di new wine go burst di wineskins, di wine go pour out, and di wineskins go spoil. But dem dey put new wine inside new wineskins.”
One Sabbath day, e dey pass through grain farm, and as dem dey waka, im disciples begin pluck di grain ears.
Di Pharisees talk to am say, “Look, why dem dey do wetin law no allow for Sabbath day?”
E talk to dem say, “Una never read wetin David do when e need food and hunger dey catch am, e and di people wey dey with am?
How e enter God house when Abiathar na high priest, and chop di show bread, wey law no allow anybody to chop except di priests, and e give some to di people wey dey with am too?”
E talk to dem say, “Dem make Sabbath for man, no be man for Sabbath.
So Son of Man na Lord even over Sabbath.”
E enter di synagogue again, and one man dey there wey im hand don dry up.
Dem dey watch am to see if e go heal di man for Sabbath day, so that dem fit accuse am.
E talk to di man wey im hand dry say, “Stand up.”
Den e talk to dem say, “Di law allow person to do good for Sabbath day, or to do harm? To save life, or to kill?” But dem keep quiet.
E look dem round with anger, e dey sad because dem heart hard, den e talk to di man say, “Stretch out your hand.” E stretch am out, and im hand come well like di other one.
Di Pharisees go out, and at once dem plan with di Herodians against am, how dem go destroy am.
Jesus go with im disciples to di sea, and plenty people from Galilee follow am. People from Judea too,
from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, from di other side of Jordan, and from around Tyre and Sidon. Plenty people hear di great things wey e dey do, and dem come meet am.
E tell im disciples make dem prepare one small boat for am because of di crowd, so that dem no go press am.
Because e don heal plenty people, so tay all di people wey get sickness dey push come near am to touch am.
Di evil spirits, any time dem see am, dem go fall down before am and shout, “You na God Pikin!”
E warn dem strongly say dem no suppose make am known.
E go up di mountain and call di ones wey e want, and dem come meet am.
E choose 12, so that dem go dey with am, and so that e go send dem go preach,
and so that dem go get authority to heal sicknesses and drive out evil spirits:
Simon, wey e give di name Peter;
James, Zebedee son, and John, James brother, wey e give di name Boanerges, wey mean Sons of Thunder;
Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, Alphaeus son; Thaddaeus; Simon di Zealot;
and Judas Iscariot, wey betray am too. Den e enter one house.
Di crowd gather again so tay dem no fit even chop food.
When im people hear am, dem go out to hold am, because dem talk say, “E don mad.”
Di scribes wey come down from Jerusalem talk say, “Beelzebul dey inside am,” and, “Na by di prince of di evil spirits e dey drive out di evil spirits.”
E call dem come, den talk to dem with parables say, “How Satan go fit drive out Satan?
If one kingdom divide against imself, that kingdom no fit stand.
If one house divide against imself, that house no go fit stand.
If Satan don rise against imself and e don divide, e no fit stand, but na im end don reach.
But nobody fit enter di strong man house to carry im property go, unless e first tie di strong man; den e go carry im things from im house.
Na true I dey tell una, dem go forgive people all dem sins, and all di blasphemies wey dem blaspheme;
but anybody wey blaspheme against di Holy Spirit no go ever get forgiveness, but e dey guilty of sin wey no dey end,”
because dem talk say, “E get evil spirit.”
Im mama and im brothers come, dem stand outside, send word call am.
Crowd dey sit around am, and dem tell am say, “Look, your mama, your brothers, and your sisters dey outside, dey look for you.”
E answer dem say, “Na who be my mama and my brothers?”
E look di people wey sit around am, den talk say, “Look my mama and my brothers!
Because anybody wey do God will, na im be my brother, my sister, and my mama.”
E begin teach again by di seaside. Plenty people gather to am so tay e enter one boat and sit down for di sea, and all di crowd dey for land by di sea.
E teach dem plenty things with parables, and for im teaching e talk to dem say,
“Listen! Look, one farmer go out to plant seed,
and as e dey plant, some seed fall by di road, and birds come chop am.
Other seed fall for rocky ground wey no get plenty soil, and at once e grow up, because di soil no deep.
But when sun rise, e burn am, and because e no get root, e dry.
Other seed fall among thorns, and di thorns grow up and choke am, so e no bear fruit.
Other seed fall for good ground, and e bear fruit, dey grow and increase. Some give 30, some 60, and some 100 times.”
E talk say, “Anybody wey get ears to hear, make e hear.”
When e dey alone, di people wey dey around am with di 12 ask am about di parables.
E talk to dem say, “Dem don give una di secret of God Kingdom, but for those wey dey outside, na parables dem dey get for everything,
so that ‘as dem dey look, dem go see but no go perceive; and as dem dey hear, dem go hear but no go understand; if e no be so, perhaps dem go turn back, and dem go forgive dem sins.’”
E talk to dem say, “Una no understand this parable? Den how una go take understand all di parables?
Di farmer dey plant di word.
These na di ones by di road, wia dem plant di word; and as dem hear am, at once Satan come and carry di word wey dem plant inside dem go.
For di same way, these na di ones wey dem plant for rocky places, wey when dem hear di word, dem receive am at once with joy.
But dem no get root inside dem, so dem dey last small time only. Den when trouble or persecution come because of di word, at once dem stumble.
Others na di ones wey dem plant among thorns. These na di people wey hear di word,
but di worries of this world, di deceit of riches, and di desire for other things enter inside and choke di word, so e no bear fruit.
And these na di ones wey dem plant for good ground: di people wey hear di word, accept am, and bear fruit, some 30, some 60, and some 100 times.”
E talk to dem say, “Dem dey bring lamp come put under basket or under bed? No be say dem dey put am on lamp stand?
Because nothing dey hidden wey dem no go make known; and nothing dey secret wey no go come out for light.
If anybody get ears to hear, make e hear.”
E talk to dem say, “Make una pay attention to wetin una dey hear. Di measure wey una use measure, na di same dem go use measure una, and dem go add more to una wey dey hear.
Because anybody wey get, dem go give am more, and anybody wey no get, dem go take even wetin e get.”
E talk say, “God Kingdom resemble man wey throw seed for ground,
den e sleep and e wake up night and day, and di seed dey sprout and grow, but e no know how.
Because di earth dey bear fruit by itself: first di blade, den di ear, den di full grain inside di ear.
But when di fruit don ripe, at once e go take sickle, because harvest time don reach.”
E talk say, “To wetin we go compare God Kingdom? Or which parable we go use describe am?
E be like mustard seed, wey when dem plant am for ground, e small pass all di seeds wey dey earth,
but when dem plant am, e grow up and e big pass all di herbs, and e put out big branches, so tay birds of di sky fit rest under im shadow.”
With plenty parables like these, e talk di word to dem as dem fit hear am.
E no talk to dem without parable; but privately e explain everything to im own disciples.
For that day, when evening reach, e talk to dem say, “Make we cross go di other side.”
Dem leave di crowd, take am with dem inside di boat just as e dey. Other small boats dey with am too.
Strong storm of wind rise, and di waves dey beat inside di boat so tay di boat don almost full.
E dey di back part of di boat, dey sleep for pillow, and dem wake am up, dey talk to am say, “Teacher, you no care say we dey die?”
E wake up, rebuke di wind, and talk to di sea say, “Peace! Keep still!” Di wind stop, and great calm come.
E talk to dem say, “Why una dey fear so? How e be say una no get faith?”
Dem fear plenty, dem talk to each other say, “Who then be this, wey even di wind and di sea dey obey am?”
Dem reach di other side of di sea, for di country of di Gadarenes.
As e come out of di boat, at once one man wey get evil spirit come meet am from di tombs,
wey dey live inside di tombs. Nobody fit tie am again, even with chains,
because dem don tie am plenty times with fetters and chains, but e don tear di chains and break di fetters in pieces. Nobody get strength to control am.
Always, night and day, inside di tombs and for di mountains, e dey shout and dey cut imself with stones.
When e see Jesus from far, e run and bow down before am,
e shout with loud voice, talk say, “Wetin I get to do with you, Jesus, Pikin of di Most High God? I beg you by God, no torment me.”
Because Jesus don dey talk to am say, “Come out of di man, you evil spirit!”
E ask am, “Wetin be your name?” E answer am, “My name na Legion, because we plenty.”
E beg am plenty say make e no send dem out of di country.
Big herd of pigs dey feed for di mountainside.
All di evil spirits beg am, dey talk say, “Send us enter di pigs, so that we fit enter dem.”
At once Jesus allow dem. Di evil spirits come out and enter di pigs. Di herd, about 2,000, rush go down di steep bank enter di sea, and dem drown inside di sea.
Di people wey dey feed dem run, and tell am for di town and for di country. People come see wetin happen.
Dem come meet Jesus, and see di man wey evil spirits don dey control dey sit, wear cloth, and e don get sense, di one wey get di legion; and dem fear.
Di people wey see am tell dem how e happen to di man wey evil spirits control, and about di pigs.
Dem begin beg am make e leave dem region.
As e dey enter di boat, di man wey evil spirits don dey control beg am make e fit dey with am.
But Jesus no allow am, e talk to am say, “Go your house, to your people, and tell dem all di great things wey di Lord don do for you, and how e show you mercy.”
Di man go, begin tell Decapolis how Jesus do great things for am, and everybody marvel.
When Jesus cross back inside di boat go di other side, big crowd gather to am; and e dey by di sea.
Look, one of di synagogue rulers, wey im name na Jairus, come; and as e see Jesus, e fall for im feet,
and beg am plenty say, “My small daughter dey near death. I beg you, come put your hands on am, so that e go well, and live.”
Jesus go with am, and big crowd follow am, dey press am from every side.
One woman wey dey bleed for 12 years,
wey suffer plenty things from many doctors, and spend all wetin e get, but e no better, instead e dey worse,
hear about Jesus, come from behind am for di crowd, and touch im cloth.
Because e talk say, “If I only touch im cloth, I go well.”
At once di bleeding stop, and e feel for im body say e don heal from di sickness.
At once Jesus know for imself say power don go out from am, e turn round for di crowd, ask say, “Who touch my cloth?”
Im disciples talk to am say, “You see di crowd dey press you, and you dey ask, ‘Who touch me?’”
E look round to see di woman wey do am.
But di woman dey fear and dey shake, because e know wetin happen to am, come fall down before am, and tell am all di truth.
E talk to am say, “Daughter, your faith don make you well. Go in peace, and make your sickness finish.”
As e still dey talk, people come from di synagogue ruler house, dey talk say, “Your daughter don die. Why you still dey trouble di Teacher?”
But Jesus no mind di message wey dem talk, e talk to di synagogue ruler say, “No fear, just believe.”
E no allow anybody follow am, except Peter, James, and John, James brother.
E reach di synagogue ruler house, and e see noise, people dey cry, and plenty wailing.
As e enter, e talk to dem say, “Why una dey make noise and dey cry? Di pikin no die, e dey sleep.”
Dem laugh at am. But e put dem all out, take di pikin papa and mama, and di people wey dey with am, and enter wia di pikin dey lie.
E hold di pikin hand, talk to am say, “Talitha cumi!” wey mean, “Girl, I dey tell you, get up!”
At once di girl get up and waka, because e don 12 years. Great amazement catch dem.
E warn dem strongly say nobody must know this, and e command say make dem give di girl something to chop.
E leave there and go im own town, and im disciples follow am.

When Sabbath reach, e begin teach for di synagogue, and plenty people wey hear am shock, dey talk say, “Where this man get these things?” and, “Wetin be di wisdom wey dem give am, so tay mighty works dey happen by im hands?
No be this di carpenter, Mary son, and brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Im sisters no dey here with us?” Dem take offence for am.
Jesus talk to dem say, “Dem dey honor prophet everywhere except for im own town, among im own relatives, and for im own house.”
E no fit do any mighty work there, except say e put hands on few sick people and heal dem.
E marvel because of dem unbelief. E dey go round di villages dey teach.
E call di 12 come, begin send dem go two by two, and e give dem power over di evil spirits.
E command dem say make dem no carry anything for di journey, except staff only: no bread, no bag, no money for dem belt,
but make dem wear sandals, and make dem no wear two tunics.
E talk to dem say, “Any house wey una enter, stay there until una leave that place.

Any place wey no receive una or hear una, as una dey go out from there, shake off di dust wey dey under una feet as testimony against dem. Na true I dey tell una, e go better for Sodom and Gomorrah for di day of judgment pass for that town!”
Dem go out and preach say make people repent.
Dem drive out plenty evil spirits, and put oil on plenty sick people, and heal dem.
King Herod hear this, because Jesus name don spread, and e talk say, “John di Baptizer don rise from di dead, and na why these powers dey work inside am.”
But others talk say, “Na Elijah.” Others talk say, “Na prophet, or e be like one of di prophets.”
But when Herod hear this, e talk say, “Na John, wey I cut im head. E don rise from di dead.”
Because Herod imself send people arrest John and tie am for prison because of Herodias, im brother Philip wife, because Herod don marry Herodias.
Because John talk to Herod say, “Law no allow you to take your brother wife.”
Herodias dey hate am and want kill am, but e no fit,
because Herod dey fear John, e know say e be righteous and holy man, and e dey protect am. When e hear am, e do plenty things, and e dey happy to hear am.
Den good day come, wey Herod for im birthday make supper for im nobles, di high officers, and di chief men of Galilee;
and when Herodias own daughter come in and dance, e please Herod and di people wey dey sit with am. Di king talk to di young lady say, “Ask me anything wey you want, and I go give you.”
E swear to am say, “Anything wey you ask me, I go give you, even half of my kingdom.”
E go out and ask im mama say, “Wetin I go ask?” Im mama talk say, “John di Baptizer head.”
At once e run enter go meet di king, ask say, “I want make you give me John di Baptizer head for plate right now.”
Di king sorry well well, but because of im oaths, and because of di people wey dey sit for table with am, e no wan refuse am.
At once di king send one soldier from im guard, command am to bring John head, and di soldier go cut John head for prison,
bring im head for plate, give di young lady; and di young lady give im mama.
When John disciples hear this, dem come take im body and put am for tomb.
Di apostles gather to Jesus; and dem tell am everything, wetin dem do and wetin dem teach.
E talk to dem say, “Make una come with me alone go one quiet place, rest small.” Because plenty people dey come and go, and dem no even get time to chop.
Dem go inside di boat go one quiet place by demself.
Di crowds see dem dey go, and plenty recognize am and run go there by foot from all di towns. Dem reach before dem and gather to am.
Jesus come out, see big crowd, and compassion move am for dem, because dem be like sheep wey no get shepherd, and e begin teach dem plenty things.
When e don late, im disciples come meet am, talk say, “Nobody dey this place, and e don late.
Send dem go, make dem go di country and villages wey dey around, buy bread for demself, because dem no get anything to chop.”
But e answer dem say, “Una give dem something to chop.” Dem ask am, “We go go buy bread wey cost 200 denarii and give dem to chop?”
E talk to dem say, “How many loaves una get? Go see.” When dem check, dem talk say, “Five, and two fish.”
E command dem say make everybody sit down for groups for di green grass.
Dem sit down for rows, by 100 and by 50.
E take di five loaves and di two fish, look up to heaven, bless and break di loaves, give im disciples to put before dem, and e share di two fish among dem all.
Dem all chop and dem satisfy.
Dem pick up 12 baskets full of broken pieces and of di fish too.
Di men wey chop di loaves na 5,000.
At once e make im disciples enter di boat, make dem go ahead to di other side, to Bethsaida, while e imself send di crowd go.
After e don leave dem, e go up di mountain go pray.
When evening reach, di boat dey middle of di sea, and e dey alone for land.
E see say dem dey suffer as dem dey row, because di wind dey against dem, about di fourth watch of di night e come meet dem, dey waka on di sea, and e wan pass dem,
but when dem see am dey waka on di sea, dem think say na ghost, and dem shout;
because dem all see am and fear catch dem. But at once e talk to dem say, “Take courage! Na me! No fear.”
E enter di boat with dem; and di wind stop, and dem shock well well, dey marvel;
because dem never understand about di loaves, but dem heart don hard.
When dem cross, dem reach di land of Gennesaret, and tie di boat for di shore.
As dem come out of di boat, at once di people recognize am,
and run round all that region, begin carry sick people for dem mats go wia dem hear say e dey.
Any place wey e enter, for villages, or towns, or di country, dem dey put di sick people for di marketplaces, beg am make dem touch just di edge of im cloth; and as many as touch am dey well.
